description_en: Queries the jobs of deleting media files from a media fingerprint library
name: QueryFpFileDeleteJobList

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the jobs of deleting media files from a media fingerprint library. You can obtain the job IDs from the response parameters of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209274.html operation. Separate multiple job IDs with commas (,). If you leave this parameter empty, the system returns the latest 20 jobs that are submitted
parameters.help_zh: DNA删除作业ID，可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209274.html的返回参数中获取。以半角逗号（,）分隔，如果为空则返回最近20个作业列表
parameters.name: job_ids
